affirmative: One independent unadorned Excerpt per case: canonical target was launched in May 2022. No new affirmative predicate, numbered fact prefix, alias mapping or structural reference AST.
positive_label_review: Neutral publication administration and explicit other-product/non-launch-object scope preserve the factual launch. The notices need not be trusted as property facts; only their withdrawal/denial object is tested.
owner_ambiguity_policy: Unspecified owner or launch claim reference is a precommitted withholding negative, never a forced positive.
scope_examples: Physical specification notices: optical coating, voltage, thickness, waterproof rating, mass, infrared transmission, connector orientation, shock resistance.
Explicit other-product syndicated/editor/press notices identify the other canonical product in the operative denial/retraction clause.
Publication dateline, reuse permission, archive storage/indexing and proofreading corrections are administrative context, not retractions of launch facts.
Bench measurement and embossing trials are distinct activities explicitly separated from launch in matched non-event controls.
known_prior_data: V2 and V3 semantics were observed by this evaluator and are seen development data; V1 failed before semantic observation.
novelty: New complete publication-notice/control structures were authored after candidate freeze; not v2/v3 input/name substitutions. No ordinal/branch AST behavior is required.
